meta.title: Fares' Steakhouse | Tabuk
meta.description: Tabuk's premier destination for exceptional steak. Hand-selected cuts, masterful preparation, and an unforgettable VIP dining experience.

hero.title: Where Meat Becomes Art
hero.subtitle: Exceptional cuts, perfect doneness, and an unparalleled dining experience. Welcome to Fares' Steakhouse.

cuts.title: Mastery of the Cut
cuts.subtitle: We source the finest cuts from the world's best producers and prepare them with uncompromising expertise.

items.name: Ribeye
items.description: The richest cut. Exceptional marbling that melts on the tongue with every bite.

items.name: Filet Mignon
items.description: The most tender cut. Butter-soft in every slice, crafted for those who appreciate refinement.

items.name: New York Strip
items.description: The perfect balance of flavor and tenderness. A firm bite with unforgettable taste.

items.name: T-Bone
items.description: The best of both worlds: strip and filet united in one remarkable cut.

items.name: Tomahawk
items.description: The showpiece. A bone-in ribeye with theatrical presentation worthy of grand occasions.

doneness.title: Doneness Guide
doneness.subtitle: Every level of doneness tells a different story. Choose what suits your palate.

levels.name: Blue Rare
levels.description: Cool red center, barely seared surface

levels.name: Medium Rare
levels.description: Warm pink center, ideal for most premium cuts

levels.name: Medium Well
levels.description: Slight hint of pink, mostly cooked through

experience.title: The Fares Experience
experience.subtitle: Not just a meal, but a sensory journey that begins the moment you walk through our doors.

features.title: Global Sourcing
features.description: We import the finest meats from Australia, Argentina, and Japan. Every cut is hand-selected with extraordinary care.

features.title: Charcoal Grilling
features.description: We employ precision grilling techniques at carefully calibrated temperatures to ensure the perfect crust and complete juiciness.

features.title: Expert Aging
features.description: Our dry-aging program extends up to 45 days, concentrating flavors and achieving exceptional tenderness.

features.title: Personal Service
features.description: A service team trained to the highest standards, understanding your preferences and anticipating your needs.

vip.title: Your Private Table Awaits
vip.subtitle: Private dining rooms designed for absolute privacy. Perfect for business meetings, special occasions, or a quiet evening away from the world.
features: Custom menus tailored to your preferences

beverages.title: The Perfect Pairing
beverages.subtitle: Premium beverages crafted to enhance the flavor of every cut.

items.name: Smoked Cherry Mocktail
items.description: A smoked black cherry creation, designed specifically to complement Ribeye cuts.

items.name: Concentrated Pomegranate Juice
items.description: Fresh pomegranate with a touch of rosemary. Balanced acidity that cuts through the richness of the meat.

items.name: Premium Arabic Coffee
items.description: Carefully roasted beans with premium cardamom and saffron. The perfect conclusion to every meal.

items.name: Imported Sparkling Water
items.description: A selection of the finest mineral sparkling waters from around the world.

items.name: Khalid M.
items.text: The best steak I have tasted in the Kingdom. The cuts are exceptional and the service is world-class. My preferred venue for important meetings.

items.name: Abdullah R.
items.text: The Tomahawk here is a work of art. Perfect doneness, theatrical presentation, and indescribable flavor. Fares has raised the bar in Tabuk.

items.name: Mohammed F.
items.text: The private room is perfect for occasions. I have been celebrating every important milestone here for years. The service team knows my preferences exactly.

reservation.title: Ready for an Extraordinary Experience?
reservation.subtitle: Reserve your table now via WhatsApp and enjoy the VIP service you deserve.
